t: Public Service Internship Programme (PSIP) – Apply Online
x:
The Public Service Commission (PSC) places Kenyan graduates in ministries, state departments and other public bodies under the Public Service Internship Programme. According to the Commission's guidelines, interns are unemployed graduates from recognised institutions, the internship lasts 12 months, and interns receive a monthly stipend.

How to apply: applications are made online on the PSC recruitment portal using the Apply button. Each advert lists its own positions, eligibility and closing date, so read the current advert carefully before you submit.

Documents to prepare: national ID, degree or diploma certificate and transcript, KRA PIN and a certificate of good conduct. Applying is free, so never pay anyone to be considered.

Carrot, a global fertility and family care platform, is hiring a hands-on security leader to run security operations and guide safe adoption of AI tools. The role covers the incident lifecycle, SIEM detections and automation, management of the managed security provider, and security of corporate systems and collaboration AI tools. It involves working with IT, Legal, Privacy and Engineering in a healthcare environment.

Carrot, a global fertility and family care platform, is hiring a Manager, Product Design to lead a team of senior product designers building member-facing products. The role is player-coach, split roughly equally between hands-on design work (including design system direction) and coaching the team. Duties include leading design initiatives from strategy to launch, giving craft feedback, driving adoption of AI tools, and managing designer performance.

Carrot, a global fertility and family care platform, is hiring a Corporate Counsel to negotiate, draft and review customer and vendor contracts such as master services agreements, SLAs, professional services agreements and NDAs. The role partners with Sales and other teams to resolve redlines, advises on legal and revenue risk, and supports privacy terms including HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and Data Protection Agreements. It sits within a collaborative Legal team and uses contract lifecycle management and AI tools.

Healthie, an ONC-certified EHR platform for outpatient healthcare, is hiring a customer-facing specialist for its Private Practice Enablement team. The person will work with private practices and growing healthcare organizations through live 1:1 calls and email, covering setup, training, workflow optimization and feature adoption. The role involves building relationships with executives, practice managers, providers and clinical champions.

OKX, a crypto exchange, is hiring a remote Affiliate Manager listed with South Africa as its headquarters. The role develops and optimises affiliate campaigns, grows the affiliate network and influencer base in the local market, and analyses user behaviour to improve conversion. Candidates need 3+ years of affiliate marketing or business development experience in crypto, experience building large affiliate networks, and skill with analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Amplitude.

The Kenya Defence Forces is recruiting in several categories, including general service officer cadets, specialist officers, general duty recruits and tradesmen and women. Applicants must be Kenyan citizens who meet the age, KCSE or diploma, medical and physical requirements in the official advert, and applications for cadets, specialists and tradesmen and women are submitted online. Recruitment is free, so never pay anyone to be considered.

Storyblok, a headless CMS company, is hiring a Senior Product Architect to own the technical architecture, platform vision and scalability of its products. The role involves setting architectural guardrails, leading design reviews and working with Product, Security, DevOps and Data teams. It requires 7+ years in software architecture or system design, with cloud-native expertise (AWS preferred), and is fully remote with a home office package and a monthly remote work stipend.

Remote clinician role on Talkspace's Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program team. The schedule is Monday-Friday with rotating Saturdays or Tuesday-Saturday, 9am-5pm Eastern or Central time.

Ritual is building a blockchain designed for AI applications, and this role integrates its AI infrastructure with partner apps and protocols. The work covers scoping, development, deployment and maintenance of integrations, technical support for partners, and documentation for APIs and SDKs. Candidates need blockchain engineering skills, Solidity and EVM experience, and fluency in Python or TypeScript.

Ritual is building a blockchain for AI-native applications, and this role builds web interfaces for its AI and blockchain infrastructure. The work covers transaction monitoring, node deployment and management dashboards, and DeFi-style protocol interfaces. It calls for strong TypeScript, React, EVM wallet integration (wagmi, ethers) and full-stack skills.
